reasons.utilization: Synthesized area is 1938.1 um^2 (182 cells, reports/synth_tool.json). 40% core utilization gives about 4845 um^2 of core (~70 x 70 um), inside the allowed 30-65% range. Chosen slightly below the 45% default because the block is tiny: a little extra core keeps the 33 I/O pins at a comfortable pitch on the perimeter, leaves room for the default SKY130 PDN straps and for resizer/hold buffers, and timing slack (2.92 ns pre-layout at ss) does not need a tighter, shorter-wire layout.
reasons.pins: Follows arch.yaml data flow: operands and opcode (a[7:0], b[7:0], op[2:0]) enter on the West edge feeding alu8_core; registered outputs (result[7:0], flag_z/c/v/n) leave on the East edge from alu8_regs, so data flows left to right with no crossing. 33 pins total, each matched by exactly one pattern.
reasons.power_grid: Default SKY130 PDN from the PDK/OpenLane configuration (pnr_ranges.yaml defines no strap pitch/width ranges, so straps stay at default). Connectivity and powered-row checks are left to the real PDN step.
reasons.clock_reset: clk is placed alone on the North edge so the single clock net enters away from the data buses; rst_n (synchronous, only drives the 12-flop register bank) is placed alone on the South edge. Neither shares an edge with the data buses, keeping the ordered bus pins contiguous.
